commits.subject: feat: live session sync and active indicator improvements
commits.body:
- Rename isActive → isActiveSession and fix logic to use lastActivity < 10min
  instead of unreliable in-memory SDK active query check
- Add silentSyncMessages composable that polls for new terminal messages
  every 3s without triggering loading state or replacing the full message array
- Compute isSessionLive on the frontend with a 60s ticker so the green dot
  stays reactive without server round-trips
- Move active indicator into the same slot as edit/delete buttons: dot shows
  at rest, fades out on hover as buttons fade in
